entries.proposition: System: Wistar rat pups, prenatal LPS at embryonic day 20 and 80 percent oxygen for 48 hours from postnatal day 3 to 5, analysed at P5 and P11; an injury model of encephalopathy of prematurity. No WWOX and no therapeutic oxygen.
entries.snippet: Offspring were exposed to hyperoxia (80% O2) from postnatal day 3 (P3) to P5, aligning with the brain development stage of a preterm infant at 26–28 weeks of gestation

entries.proposition: Design: 94 pups from nine litters in four groups; both sexes pooled (28 female and 32 male at P11).
entries.snippet: In total 94 pups derived from nine litters were enrolled in this study.

entries.proposition: Hyperoxia alone: acute oligodendrocyte degeneration and fewer mature oligodendrocytes at P5, independent of prenatal LPS.
entries.snippet: postnatal hyperoxia leads to acute oligodendrocyte degeneration associated with reduced numbers of mature oligodendrocytes

entries.proposition: Hypomyelination from hyperoxia alone is marked; the combination is stronger (reported as additive for MBP area).
entries.snippet: Confirming previous work [21, 25, 27, 59], postnatal hyperoxia resulted in a marked hypomyelination revealed by a reduction of MBP positive area

entries.proposition: Prenatal LPS, not hyperoxia, drove the growth, fibre-length and microglial-elongation effects.
entries.snippet: Nevertheless, the main factor contributing to reduced growth was prenatal LPS exposure

entries.proposition: Brain and serum cytokines move in opposite directions, and one is measured as mRNA and the other as protein.
entries.snippet: we observed the opposite regulation, as shown by a reduction of pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokines in the combined setting

entries.proposition: The authors caution that mRNA in brain and protein in serum are not directly comparable.
entries.snippet: data need to be interpreted with caution, considering different methods of cytokine analyses (i.e. protein analysis in serum vs. mRNA expression analyses in brain samples)

entries.proposition: The correlations in Figure 7 mainly appear when the double-hit group is included.
entries.snippet: These moderate to strong correlations were mainly observed when the double hit group was included

entries.proposition: Definition of synergy used: no single-insult difference but a significant combined difference, plus a two-way ANOVA interaction.
entries.snippet: We defined synergistic effects between treatment groups when single insults did not show differences compared to controls, but the combination of insults resulted in significant group differences

entries.proposition: Long-term neurodevelopmental outcome was not studied and the authors say so.
entries.snippet: Therefore, future studies should investigate long-term neurodevelopmental outcomes in the present injury model, which was beyond the scope of this study.

entries.proposition: Data availability statement says no datasets were generated or analysed, although the study reports original animal data.
entries.snippet: No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study.

entries.proposition: Supplementary Table S2: the hippocampal MBP-area interaction is not significant (F = 3.039, p = 0.0868) while the hyperoxia main effect is very large (F = 97.21), so the MBP effect is hyperoxia-dominated and additive, and the brain-volume interaction is significant (F = 8.370, p = 0.0054).
entries.snippet: Interaction LPS x 80% O2 F (1, 56) = 8.370 p= 0.0054 (**)

entries.proposition: Figures 1 to 4: P5 and P11 weights, length and serum leptin (leptin up with LPS, higher with both); brain volume about 123 in controls and about 103 mm3 in the double hit with single hits near 120; TBR1 layer thinning only in the double hit at the hippocampal level; TUNEL-positive oligodendrocytes about 15 against about 3 per mm2 with hyperoxia, CC1 mature cells lower; MBP area about 9 falling to about 6 with hyperoxia and about 4 in the double hit.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 1 A-G, Figure 2 A-E, Figure 3 A-I, Figure 4 A-F scatter plots with asterisks.

entries.proposition: Figures 5 to 7: CD68 and Iba1 areas highest in the double hit, brain IL-6 highest with LPS plus hyperoxia, serum IL-6, IL-4 and IL-10 lower with hyperoxia; the principal component plot separates the double hit from the rest; the correlation panels (r 0.48 to 0.75 and -0.64 to -0.75) plot only the control (NaCl, 21 percent) and double-hit (LPS, 80 percent) groups, so each correlation spans two separated clusters.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 5 A-C, Figure 6 A-D, Figure 7 PCA and B-H correlations with legend NaCl+21% O2 and LPS+80% O2 only.
